situation: My coworker Anika told me in our 1:1 that I talk over people in team meetings, especially the junior folks, Sam and Lucy. It stung but I think she's right. Want to message her after.
reply: Thanks for telling me that earlier, Anika, I know it wasn't an easy thing to raise. You're right that I jump in before people finish, and I hadn't noticed it was mostly with Sam and Lucy. I'm going to hold my comments until they've wrapped up. Would you give me a nudge after our next team meeting if I slip?
note: Reflect the point, own it without explaining it away, and ask for help catching it next time.

situation: 我在家长群里组织了班级春游，王妈妈在群里说我选的地方太远、费用太高也没跟大家商量。其实我提前在群里发过投票；费用确实比去年高，主要是今年多了一段大巴。
reply: 谢谢王妈妈提出来。费用比去年高这点确实是，主要是今年多了一段大巴。地点之前在群里发过投票，可能消息多被刷过去了，下次我会单独@大家确认。费用和路程的具体情况我私下跟您细说，免得刷屏。
note: 公开场合：认下对的部分，平静说明一次事实，然后转私聊，不在群里辩。

situation: My manager said in my review that I'm 'not a team player' because I declined to join the weekend offsite planning committee. I don't think that's fair, I led two cross-team projects this year, the checkout redesign and the vendor consolidation, each with three other teams.
reply: Thanks for being direct about it. I see this differently: this year I led the checkout redesign and the vendor consolidation, both with three other teams, and I'd count that as team work. I'm not trying to shut the feedback down, I just don't want to agree with something I don't think is accurate. Could you tell me what you'd want to see from me that I'm missing?
note: You don't have to agree or fight. State your view once and ask a question that moves it forward.

situation: 最好的朋友阿琳微信跟我说，我这两个月放了她三次鸽子，每次都是临时说加班，她觉得自己在我生活里排在最后。鸽子确实是我放的，加班也是真的。这周六中午我已经空出来了，想请她吃她喜欢的那家云南菜。
reply: 你说得对，这两个月我放了你三次鸽子，每次还都是最后一刻才说，换我也会觉得自己被排在后面。谢谢你直接告诉我，而不是就这么冷下来。这周六中午我请你吃那家云南菜好不好？那天我已经空出来了，一定到。
note: 对方说的是事实就直接认，不提加班；这时候的解释听起来就是借口。用一次具体的赴约来证明。

situation: I own a small bakery and asked my mentor Megan, who ran a café for 20 years, to look over my new menu. She said it's 'all over the place': 34 items is too many for a two-person kitchen and the prices look random. She's right about the number of items; every price is three times its ingredient cost, but that isn't written down anywhere.
reply: Thanks for being so straight with me, Megan, it's exactly why I asked you. You're right that 34 items is too many for the two of us, and I'm going to cut it to about 20. On prices I see it a bit differently: each one is three times its ingredient cost, though I can see that doesn't show on the menu. Would you look at the shorter version with the costings next to it? I'll send it by Friday 16 October.
note: Criticism you asked for: thank them for the honesty you wanted, act on the fair part, and show your reasoning on the rest instead of defending it.

situation: I manage a team of six. My report Tomás told me in our 1:1 that my feedback on his work is too vague to act on, like just writing 'tighten this up'. Partly fair, but I did give him detailed notes on the Q3 deck. We have 1:1s on Thursdays, and I want to follow up in writing now.
reply: Thanks for saying this to me directly, Tomás. I know that's not an easy thing to tell your manager. What I heard is that comments like 'tighten this up' leave you guessing what I actually want, and you're right, I do that more than I'd like. The notes on the Q3 deck are closer to what you need, so I'll use those as the model: every comment will say what to change and why. Tell me in our 1:1 on Thursday whether it's working.
note: Criticism from someone junior: thank the courage, agree without grovelling, point to the part that already works as the standard, then commit to a check.

situation: 昨天家里吃饭，我说辞职做自由摄影师，我爸当着亲戚的面说我'三十岁了还不务正业，存款花完了看你怎么办'。话很难听，但存款那块他说得有点道理，我只准备了六个月的生活费。想给他发个微信。
reply: 爸，昨天吃饭的事我想了一晚上。您担心我存款不够，这点您说得对，六个月的生活费确实不宽裕。我会把每个月的收入和开支记下来，到明年三月如果收入还不稳定，就先找份兼职顶上。做摄影这个决定我是认真想过的，这点咱们看法不一样。另外想跟您提个请求：以后这种事咱们单独聊，别当着亲戚的面，好吗？我周六回家，想跟您好好说说我的计划。
note: 三个桶分开放：认下对的（存款），平静说出不同意的（这个决定），对当众批评的方式提一个请求；不逐条辩解。

situation: My husband Ben said last night that I keep making weekend plans for both of us without checking with him. I did just commit us to my sister Claire's on Saturday the 10th without asking. He's right. Want to text him from work.
reply: I've been thinking about what you said last night, and you're right. I've been booking our weekends and telling you afterwards, and Claire's on the 10th is the latest one. I don't want to be the person who does that. So, starting now: do you want to go on the 10th, or shall I tell her another weekend works better? And if I do it again, tell me right then.
note: Pattern criticism from a partner: agree plainly with no explanation, prove it on the very next decision, and ask to be caught in the moment.

situation: At 11pm my teammate Olu posted a long message in our team channel saying I 'botched' last night's on-call incident because I didn't page the database team for 40 minutes. The 40 minutes is true, the rest I'm not sure about, and I'm too wound up to answer properly right now.
reply: Thanks for laying it out, Olu. You're right that I waited about 40 minutes before paging the database team, and I own that. There are a couple of other points I want to answer properly rather than defensively, so I'll come back to you directly by noon tomorrow.
note: When it stings: own the true part now, buy time for the rest with a firm time, and don't argue the details in the channel at 11pm.

situation: 我是社区志愿者服务队的排班负责人。张阿姨私信我，说我偏心，周末的好班总给年轻人，她们老同志只能排工作日下午。其实排班一直按报名先后，周末的班每次开放后半小时就报满了。不过开放时间是晚上十点，确实对老人不太友好。
reply: 张阿姨，谢谢您直接跟我说，没憋在心里。您是觉得周末的班总轮不到老同志，这个我明白。偏心这点我想说清楚：排班一直按报名先后，我没有挑人。但您提醒得对，晚上十点开放报名，对早睡的人确实不公平。下个月起我改成上午九点开放，再给每人每月留一个周末班。您看这样行吗？
note: 三个桶分开放：认下对的（开放时间），平静说明不同意的（偏心），再给出具体的改法。

situation: Our downstairs neighbour Mr. Hughes left a note saying our kids stomp 'all day and night' and we're inconsiderate. They do run around between 5 and 7pm, but they're in bed by 8 and the flat is quiet after that. I'm Emma in flat 2, and we've ordered thick rugs for the living room and hallway that arrive this week.
reply:
Hi Mr. Hughes, thank you for the note, and I'm sorry the noise has been getting to you. You're right that the kids are loud between about 5 and 7, and we've ordered thick rugs for the living room and hallway that arrive this week. They're asleep by 8, so if you're hearing noise late at night it may be coming from elsewhere. Could you let me know roughly when? I'd like to sort this properly.
Emma, flat 2
note: Own the part that's true with a concrete fix, disagree on the rest with a question, and leave 'inconsiderate' alone.

situation: My 15-year-old daughter Lily snapped at dinner that I 'never listen' and I'm 'always on my phone'. I have been answering work emails at the table a lot lately, including when she tried to tell me about her audition. I don't think I never listen, but I want to reply by text after she's cooled off in her room.
reply: You're right that I've been on my phone at dinner way too much lately, and I'm glad you said it instead of giving up on talking to me. I don't think I never listen, but I get why it feels that way when half my attention is on work emails. From tonight my phone stays in the kitchen drawer during dinner. And I still want to hear about the audition, properly, whenever you're ready.
note: With a teenager, agree with the part that's true, name the difference in one line, and make the change something she can see tonight.

situation: I'm a freelance designer. A client, Gareth, emailed about my first three logo concepts for his furniture brand Oakline, where he'd asked for a hand-made, premium look: 'these look like clip art, not what we paid for'. Harsh, but concept B does use a pretty generic tree shape.
reply: Thanks for the frank feedback, Gareth. What I'm hearing is that the concepts feel generic rather than the hand-made, premium look you described for Oakline. You're right about concept B, the tree shape is too stock and I'll drop it. Before I start round two, could you send me two or three logos you love, from any industry? I want to be sure I'm fixing the right thing, and you'll have new concepts by Friday 9 October.
note: Client criticism of your work: reflect the real point, concede the fair part, ask for references instead of defending, and give a date.

situation: 我当组长半年，这次部门匿名调研里有两条评论说我“开会只听自己想听的”“决定都是提前定好的，征求意见只是走过场”。不知道是谁写的。回头看，排期调整那次确实是我先定了方向再问大家。想在周五组会前发条消息给全组回应一下。
reply: 大家好，这次匿名调研的评论我都认真看了，谢谢愿意写真话的同事。有两条提到我开会时只听自己想听的、有些决定其实已经定了才来征求意见。我回头看了最近几次会，排期调整那次确实是我先定了方向再问大家，这一点我认。有一处我想弄明白：大家希望哪些事在我拍板前先一起讨论？周五组会我留二十分钟专门聊这个，不方便当面说的也可以私信或匿名发给我。以后需要大家意见的事，我会先说清楚是已经定了，还是真的还在讨论。
note: 匿名批评不要去猜是谁写的，对全组回应：认下具体的部分，问一个问题，给出可检验的下一步。

situation: My philosophy professor, Dr. Hartley, returned my essay with the comment 'This reads like it was generated by AI. Please see me.' I wrote it myself, and I have my handwritten notes and the doc's version history going back to Sept 14. I'm Maya Collins and I want to email her before her office hours on Thursday.
reply:
Dear Dr. Hartley,
Thank you for raising your concern with me directly. I understand that something in the essay made you doubt it was my own work, and I take that seriously. I see this differently: I wrote it myself, and I'd like to show you my handwritten notes and the document's version history, which starts on 14 September. I'll bring both to your office hours on Thursday 1 October. Could you also point me to the passages that raised the concern? I'd like to understand what prompted it.
Best regards,
Maya Collins
note: An accusation you know is wrong: acknowledge the concern, disagree once with evidence you can show, and ask a question instead of sounding offended.

situation: 我是初二的班主任。家长李妈妈发消息说，我上周在班上当众批评她儿子作业没交，孩子回家哭了，她觉得我伤了孩子的自尊。作业确实连续三次没交，但当众点名这点我自己也觉得欠妥。
reply: 李妈妈您好，谢谢您直接告诉我，听说孩子回家哭了，我心里也不好受。您说得对，上周当着全班点名批评他，这个方式不妥，我会找机会单独跟他说一声。作业连续三次没交的事，我还是希望咱们一起帮他解决。想先了解一下，他在家写作业主要卡在哪儿？这两天您哪个时间方便，我们通个电话聊十分钟？
note: 认下方式上的问题，但不因此放掉作业这件事；用一个问题把对话引向一起解决。

situation: I gave a 30-minute talk on accessibility testing at a local developer meetup last night. The organiser, Nadia, forwarded feedback: several people said it was too basic, and I ran 15 minutes over. The overrun is on me, but the event listing called the talk 'beginner friendly', so I pitched it that way.
reply: Thanks for passing this on, Nadia, and for giving me the slot. You're right about the time: I ran 15 minutes over, and next time I'll rehearse to 25 minutes so there's room for questions. On the level, the listing said 'beginner friendly' and I pitched it there, so I suspect some people came expecting something deeper. For a future talk, would you rather we label the level more clearly, or should I offer an intermediate follow-up for the people who wanted more?
note: Own the overrun without a but; the level complaint is a mismatch with the listing, so say it once and turn it into a question.

situation: My friend Jordan DM'd me that my Instagram story joking 'I'm so ADHD today lol' after losing my keys was hurtful, because she was diagnosed last year and people already don't take it seriously. I didn't mean anything by it, but I get it. I've just deleted the story.
reply: Thank you for telling me, Jordan, instead of just letting it sit. You're right: I turned something you live with into a throwaway joke about losing my keys, and I can see how that feeds people not taking it seriously. I've deleted the story. I'll think before I use it like that again, and if I slip, please call me on it.
note: Fair criticism about something public: agree without 'I didn't mean it', take the post down first, and ask to be told next time.

situation: 我在北京工作，爸妈在老家，平时主要是弟弟照顾。弟弟昨天微信说我“什么都不管，就知道打钱”，上个月爸住院他一个人在医院陪了五天，我在出差没回去。每个月我都给家里打三千，每周也跟爸妈视频。爸11月中旬要去复查。
reply: 弟，你说的我认真看了。爸住院那次我没回去，让你一个人在医院陪了五天，这是我的不对，你辛苦了。每月打钱、每周视频，我觉得也算在管，不过我明白，钱代替不了有人在身边。想问问你，平时最累的是哪一块？我们商量一下我能多担哪些。爸11月中旬复查那次，我请假回去陪。
note: 对的部分直接认，不同看法说一句就够，再问一个问题，最后给一个具体行动。

situation: Divido apartamento com a Carla há um ano. Ela me mandou no WhatsApp que eu deixo louça na pia por dias e que ela sempre acaba lavando, e que eu 'nunca ajudo em nada'. A louça é verdade nas últimas três semanas, estou no turno da noite; mas sou eu que pago as contas online e faço as compras do mês.
reply: Carla, obrigada por me falar direto. Você tem razão sobre a louça: nessas últimas três semanas deixei tudo na pia por dias e você acabou lavando por mim, e isso não é justo com você. Sobre eu nunca ajudar em nada, vejo um pouco diferente, porque cuido das contas e das compras do mês, mas entendo que a louça pesa mais no dia a dia. A partir de hoje lavo a minha antes de dormir, mesmo depois do turno. Se tiver mais alguma coisa te incomodando, prefiro saber: topa conversar no domingo?
note: Concorde com o fato concreto, discorde do 'nunca' em uma frase e sem placar.

situation: Marta, a senior engineer, commented on my pull request: 'This is overengineered, three new classes for what should be a 20-line function.' She's right about the config builder and the formatter. The third class, the retry wrapper, is there because our logs show the payment API timing out on about 1 in 50 calls.
reply: Thanks, Marta, fair catch. You're right that the config builder and the formatter are overkill, and I'll fold them into one function. The retry wrapper I'd like to keep in some form, since our logs show the payment API timing out on about 1 in 50 calls. Would a plain function with a retry loop work for you instead of a class? I'll push the changes this afternoon.
note: In a code review, agree with the specifics, give the one fact behind the part you'd keep, and end with a question rather than a defence.

situation: My son Daniel, 28, told me on the phone last night that growing up he felt nothing he did was ever good enough for me, and he brought up me calling his B+ in chemistry 'not good enough'. I did say that, though I don't think I was as harsh overall as he remembers. I want to text him today.
reply: Daniel, I've been thinking about our call. Thank you for telling me, I know that can't have been easy after all these years. What I heard is that growing up you felt nothing you did was ever good enough for me, and you're right that I said exactly that about your B+ in chemistry. I'm sorry I said it. I may remember some of those years differently, but how it felt to you matters more right now, and I'd like to hear more if you're willing. Could I call you on Sunday?
note: When an adult child criticises your parenting, own the specific thing, mention a different memory once and lightly, and ask to hear more instead of defending.

situation: I play in a Sunday league netball team. Our captain, Bex, posted in the team WhatsApp that 'some people' keep skipping Wednesday training and still expect to start on Sundays, and everyone knows she means me. I've missed three of the last four sessions because my night shift rota changed in September, and I never told anyone. My shifts change back in November and I'll be able to make every Wednesday.
reply: Fair point, Bex, and I know it's me. I've missed three of the last four Wednesdays and I should have told you why: my night shifts changed in September. They change back in November and I'll be at every session from then. Until then it's your call whether I start on Sundays, and I'm fine either way. I'll message you directly so we don't clog the chat.
note: Criticism aimed at you without your name: say 'it's me' first, give the one fact she was missing, hand her the decision, and move the rest out of the group.

situation: I was best man at my brother Owen's wedding on Saturday. Today his wife Rhiannon told me my speech hurt her: I told the story about Owen's ex turning up at his 30th, with her parents sitting right there. That story was a mistake, but I don't agree the whole speech was 'about me', since most of it was about the two of them. I want to text her.
reply: Rhiannon, thank you for telling me straight. You're right about the story about Owen's ex: it had no place at your wedding, least of all with your parents sitting there, and I'm sorry. I see the rest of the speech a bit differently, since I meant it to be about you and Owen, but I'd like to understand what made it feel otherwise. Could I take you both for lunch next weekend and say this properly?
note: Own the specific thing fully, disagree once in a clause, and ask rather than argue; she's family for life.

situation: I'm a postdoc writing our response to reviewers. Reviewer 2 called our sample of 24 participants 'woefully inadequate' and said the conclusions 'overreach'. The overreach point is fair: our discussion claims the findings generalise to older adults, but we only tested 18 to 30 year olds. The sample size was set by our preregistered power analysis for a large effect, which the Methods section didn't mention. We've now removed the generalisation claim, added it as a limitation, and stated the power analysis in Methods.
reply: We thank the reviewer for this careful reading. The reviewer is right that our discussion overreached: we tested only adults aged 18 to 30, so we have removed the claim that the findings generalise to older adults and added this as a limitation. On sample size, we see this differently: 24 participants was the number set by our preregistered power analysis for a large effect, and we now state this explicitly in the Methods. If the reviewer has a specific effect size in mind that they think the study should be powered for, we would welcome that guidance.
note: In a response to reviewers, leave the tone alone: concede the fair point with the change made, disagree once with evidence, and end on a question.

situation: 我在小红书做美食博主，昨天发了一篇本帮红烧肉的做法。有个网友在评论区说：“糖放这么多，根本不是正宗本帮红烧肉，误人子弟。”我回去一看，配料表里冰糖写成了50克，其实视频里用的是30克，是我打错了，笔记已经改成30克；不过本帮红烧肉本来就偏甜，这是我外婆教我的做法。
reply: 谢谢指出来！配料表里冰糖写成了50克，是我打错了，视频里实际用的是30克，笔记已经改过来了。本帮红烧肉偏甜是它的特点，这个做法是我外婆教的，可能和您习惯的口味不一样。喜欢少甜的话，冰糖按自己口味再减一点也可以。
note: 陌生网友的公开批评：先认下真的错并当场改掉，不同意的地方说一句就够，不接“误人子弟”这种语气。

situation: I run a weekly beginners' running club as a volunteer, Wednesdays at 6pm. A runner, Sarah, emailed that she's been left behind on the last three runs and is thinking of quitting. She's right: the faster runners set the pace, and in week one I promised nobody would get left behind.
reply: Thanks for telling me, Sarah, rather than just not turning up. You're right: the last three runs went at the faster runners' pace, and that breaks what I promised in week one. From this Wednesday I'll run at the back with anyone who wants a slower pace, and the faster group can go ahead. Would you give it one more Wednesday and tell me afterwards whether it worked?
note: When criticism comes with a threat to leave, thank them for warning you, own it without excuses, and ask for one chance to show the change.

situation: 我和大学同学阿峰合伙开了家咖啡馆，一人一半股份。他昨晚微信说我“什么都自己拍板，把他当摆设”，起因是我上周没跟他商量就花八千块换了磨豆机。磨豆机这事确实该先问他；但说我什么都自己拍板，我不同意，菜单和装修都是我们一起定的。店里周日休息。
reply: 阿峰，你的消息我想了一晚上。磨豆机这件事你说得对，八千块不是小钱，我该先跟你商量再买，这是我的问题。“什么都自己拍板”这点我看法不太一样，菜单和装修都是我们一起定的。不过我想知道，还有哪些事让你有这种感觉？我提议以后超过两千块的支出都先商量再定。周日店休，我们坐下来好好聊聊，行吗？
note: 合伙人的批评：认下具体的那件事，不同意的地方说一句，再问一个问题，并给出一条以后能检验的规矩。

situation: I moved in with my mum, who's 81, after her fall in July. This morning she snapped that I treat her like a child, because I took over her pill organiser without asking and I hover whenever she cooks. The pills part is fair, but she left the gas on twice in August, which is why I watch the cooking.
reply: Mum, I've been thinking about what you said this morning. You're right that I took over your pill organiser without asking you, and I'd hate that too, so I'm sorry. On the cooking I see it a bit differently, because the gas was left on twice in August and it frightened me. Could we sit down after lunch tomorrow and agree together how we handle both, so it's your plan as much as mine?
note: Own the fair part plainly and give the one fact behind your worry; if the gas keeps happening, ask her whether you can raise it with her GP together.

situation: 我们课程小组作业周五交，组长小陈在微信群里说我负责的文献综述“像凑字数，引用格式也乱七八糟”。引用格式确实乱，我混用了两种格式，今晚可以统一成老师要求的那种；但篇幅是按老师要求的3000字写的，内容我觉得不算凑数。
reply: 谢谢指出来。引用格式确实是我的问题，我混用了两种，今晚就统一成老师要求的格式。“凑字数”这点我看法不太一样，3000字是按老师的要求写的，我觉得内容不算凑数。不过你要是觉得哪几段可以删或者需要加强，能具体指一下吗？我私聊你，免得刷屏。
note: 群里被公开批评：先认下对的部分并给出时间，不同意的部分平静说一句，具体讨论转私聊。

situation: My friend Tamsin sent me a voice note saying my replies in our friends' group chat feel dismissive: I react with a thumbs-up to everything, including when she shared that she got her PhD place last week. She's right about the PhD news. For plans and logistics I think a thumbs-up is fine, and I'd like to take her out for a celebration dinner.
reply: Tamsin, thanks for telling me rather than letting it build up. You're right about your PhD news: a thumbs-up was a lazy reply to something that big, and I'm sorry. For plans and logistics I think the thumbs-up still does the job, but I can see how it reads when that's all I ever send. Can I take you out for a proper celebration dinner? Pick a night next week.
note: Own the moment that mattered in full, keep your view on the small stuff to one clause, and give the big news the reply it deserved.

situation: I stayed at Mrs Kowalski's holiday flat in Porto last weekend. She messaged that we left it 'filthy': we did leave dishes in the sink and the bins full, but the red wine stain on the sofa was there when we arrived, and I have a photo from check-in on Friday at 4pm. I'm happy to pay the €25 extra cleaning she mentioned.
reply: Thank you for telling me directly, Mrs Kowalski. You're right about the dishes and the full bins; we should have sorted both before we left, and I'm sorry. I'll pay the €25 extra cleaning today. The red wine stain on the sofa was already there when we arrived: I took a photo at check-in on Friday at 4pm, and I've attached it. Thank you for having us.
note: Pay for the part that's yours without a 'but', then correct the rest once, with the photo rather than with tone.

situation: 婆婆来帮我们带了一周孩子，乐乐这周跟奶奶玩得特别开心。她走前在微信上说：“你们太惯着乐乐了，吃饭还给他看平板，三岁了还天天抱着哄睡。”吃饭看平板她说得对，我们也想改；抱着哄睡是我和建军商量好的，打算明年他上幼儿园再慢慢改。
reply: 妈，这一周辛苦您了，乐乐跟您玩得特别开心。您说得对，吃饭给他看平板是我们图省事，从今天起吃饭时平板收起来。抱着哄睡是我和建军商量好的，打算明年他上幼儿园再慢慢改，这件事我们想先按自己的节奏来。以后您看到哪里不妥，随时跟我说，我宁愿早点知道。
note: 长辈批评带娃：先谢帮忙，认下对的那条并马上改，不同意的那条说明是两口子的决定，不争谁对谁错。

situation: Comparto coche para ir al trabajo con Rocío y Javier. Rocío me ha escrito por WhatsApp que conduzco demasiado rápido, que le da miedo y que además siempre llego tarde a recogerlos. Lo de la velocidad es verdad: el martes pasado fui a 140 por la autovía para no llegar tarde; pero tarde solo llegué ese día, por unas obras. A partir del lunes voy a salir diez minutos antes.
reply: Rocío, gracias por decírmelo claramente. Tienes razón con la velocidad: el martes fui a 140 por la autovía y no está bien, y menos llevándoos a vosotros. A partir del lunes salgo diez minutos antes para no ir con prisas. Lo de llegar siempre tarde lo veo distinto: solo fue ese martes, por las obras. Y si algo te da miedo mientras conduzco, dímelo en el momento, por favor.
note: Cuando la crítica toca la seguridad, se acepta sin peros y se cambia ya; el desacuerdo sobre el 'siempre' cabe en una frase.

situation: 我在一个业余乐队打鼓。排练完主唱阿乐私信我，说我“每次副歌都拖拍，整首歌都被我拖垮了”。我回去听了排练录音，第二段副歌确实拖了，但第一段没问题；桥段放慢是上周大家一起定的。下周六还要排练。
reply: 阿乐，谢谢你直接跟我说。我回去听了录音，第二段副歌确实拖了，这是我的问题，这周我每天跟着节拍器练这一段。第一段副歌我听着是稳的，桥段放慢是上周大家一起定的，这两处我看法不太一样。下周六排练时，你觉得哪里拖了，能当场提醒我吗？我想知道具体是哪几小节。
note: 用录音说话：认下录音里听得到的问题并给出练法，不同意的部分说一句，再请他当场指出具体位置。

situation: My climbing partner Ade told me after Tuesday's session at the wall that I'm a careless belayer: I was chatting to someone while he was near the top, and he had to shout 'take' twice when he slipped. Tuesday is true. But he also said I 'never' check his knot, and I do a partner check before every climb; we're climbing again on Thursday.
reply: Ade, thanks for saying it straight, that's exactly what a climbing partner should do. You're right about Tuesday: I was chatting while you were near the top, and you had to shout 'take' twice. That's not okay when your safety is in my hands, and I'm sorry. From now on, no conversations while I'm belaying. On the knot I see it differently, since I do a partner check before every climb, but let's do it out loud on Thursday so we both see it happen. See you Thursday.
note: When the criticism is about someone's safety, own the true part with no 'but', and turn the disputed part into a check you both can see.

situation: 周一部门周会上，刘经理当着全组的面说我做的季度复盘PPT“一看就没用心”。第5页的退货率我确实用错了月份，会后已经改好；但这份PPT我做了三天，说没用心我不认同。想私下给他发条微信，也想请他以后发现这类问题先私下跟我说。
reply: 刘经理，周会上您提的问题我会后认真看了。第5页的退货率确实用错了月份，是我的疏忽，已经改好，改后的版本附在下面。说没用心这点我看法不太一样，这份PPT我是花了三天认真做的。您觉得还有哪些地方需要加强，能具体指一下吗？另外想提个请求：以后发现这类问题，能不能先私下跟我说，我会马上改。
note: 被领导当众批评：私下回复，认下具体的错并说已改好，不同意的一句带过，再问一个问题，最后对方式提一个请求。

situation: Ich singe im Alt eines Laienchors. Unser Chorleiter, Herr Albrecht, hat mir per E-Mail geschrieben, dass ich bei den letzten zwei Proben meine Noten vergessen hätte und die Altstimme offenbar nicht übe. Die Noten habe ich wirklich zweimal vergessen; geübt habe ich aber jede Woche mit der Übe-Datei, nur die Stelle ab Takt 48 sitzt noch nicht. Ich heiße Katrin, und die nächste Probe ist am Dienstag.
reply: Lieber Herr Albrecht, danke für Ihre offene Nachricht. Mit den Noten haben Sie recht: Ich hatte sie zweimal nicht dabei, und ab Dienstag sind sie fest in meiner Chortasche. Beim Üben sehe ich es etwas anders, denn ich übe jede Woche mit der Übe-Datei; die Stelle ab Takt 48 sitzt allerdings noch nicht. Hätten Sie am Dienstag vor der Probe fünf Minuten, um sie kurz mit mir durchzugehen? Viele Grüße, Katrin
note: Das Wahre ohne Aber zugeben, das Falsche in einem ruhigen Satz richtigstellen und die echte Lücke in eine Bitte verwandeln.
